definition: A RecognitionProfile indexes candidate situations, their practices and a recognition-as-divine move relation, with an admitted subset and distinguished actual situation. Correct recognition is a recognition move satisfying the practice Correct predicate; outsider-shared standards are a separate predicate. The root capability is calibrated by explicit independent propositions; no actual recognition follows merely from capability.
note: Analyst reconstruction with attribution deferred. Ordinary analogy: an origin-marked message can be recognizable in a permitted circumstance while its actual community accepts no publicly answerable recognition move; private recognition need not answer to shared reason. These examples do not establish actual divine signs or correct religious practice. Admissibility and candidate-carrier adequacy are open; neither exhaustive real possibility nor a specific modal logic is imposed. OutsideAdmissibleRecognition is a first-class additional-relevant-situation witness, and AdmissibleRecognitionCoverage is an open coverage premise. No temporal persistence, causal principle or all-world accessibility is implicit.
